eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Registered with DBOCWWB in Delhi (NCT); Haryana/UP excluded.
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Up to 2 children per registered worker.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: More than 2 children or inactive membership.

benefit.summary_en: Education stipend/aid (historically ₹500/mo school up to ₹10,000/mo higher/professional courses under Rule 281 [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) for up to 2 children.
